test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Abeer, Bela, Deepa. Farheen, Heera, and Girish are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Girish sits 2nd to the right of Deepa. Farheen sits to the immediate left of Girish. Bela sits 2nd to the right of Farheen. Heera is an immediate neighbour of Deepa.

Who sits to the immediate right of Bela?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Girish sits 2nd to the right of Deepa. Farheen sits to the immediate left of Girish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/958b1b90dbb30409ca7b03870ade8d5cba2fa3c80b1e9d3ab359caf423784a0d.png] 

2) Bela sits 2nd to the right of Farheen. Heera is an immediate neighbour of Deepa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/891515a1ffedc5167d45e3401f6c5e2e37c0192f69c2cbcfbd4f0a0973306a22.png] 

Here, we can see that Abeer sits to the immediate right of Bella.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Abeer"**.
